function.name: EventSettingsApi_get_custom_event_specifications
function.description: Retrieve a list of all custom event specifications defined within the system. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

function.name: EventSettingsApi_get_event_specification_infos
function.description: Retrieves a summary of all built-in and custom event specifications within the system. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

function.name: EventSettingsApi_get_event_specification_infos_by_ids
function.description: Retrieve details for a list of event specifications using their unique identifiers. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

event_ids.description: An array of integer IDs corresponding to the event specifications to be retrieved.

include_custom.description: A flag to determine whether to include custom event specifications in the results.

include_built_in.description: A flag to determine whether to include built-in event specifications in the results.
